description: Building Height Restrictions is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Adelaide. Provides maximum allowable building height limits per defined area within the Adelaide City Council area. This layer is also currently available on our Adelaide City 3D digital model (available online at adelaidecitycouncil. com/planning-development/city-planning/3d-city-model/ ) where you can move around at different levels within the model and see where the buildings exceed height limits – i. Coverage: City of Adelaide. The portal files it under the publisher City of Adelaide. Its tags are Building, Council, Heights, Safety, development. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, kmz. The portal shows 2022-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
